response.sql:
WITH eligible_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.Date, l.PT, l.ALP, l.GPT, p.SEX
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS u
        WHERE u.ID = l.ID
          AND u.Date = l.Date
          AND u.`U-PRO` = '-'
    )
), per_patient AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX,
           AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(ALP / NULLIF(GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
    FROM eligible_lab
    GROUP BY ID, SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt,
       AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS average_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM per_patient
GROUP BY SEX

assumptions.assumption: A lab record is excluded if that same record has U-PRO = '-'; records with NULL or other U-PRO values are retained. The ALP-to-GPT ratio is calculated per record only when both values are present and GPT is nonzero.
